scope:
v3.2 pressure/audio/feedback integration audit. Executes shipping PLAY.html in
Chromium memory, with only the existing diagnostic access guard enabled. State
fixtures are controlled, actual DOM, input, audio, model and renderer run unchanged.
This is not human listening, native-device, or HTTP ES-module certification.

tests.name: User gesture unlocks four local music layers with no autoplay override
New layers share the original 90-BPM cycle without pitch or phase resets
Pile percentage drives continuous audible pressure/urgency gains on the same sources
A real falling-card impact, not just a fixture setter, increases the music pressure
WIND clears danger, preserves current typing, and releases tension without restarting music
Adaptive music switch works without altering difficulty, stock, or active card speeds
Pause and chapter results remove tension; resume restores the actual current pressure
Matching letters create local ink glints and delicate matched-key cues
Fully typed word glows but still requires Enter; saving emits one scored resolution
Wrong intermediate letters stay unpenalized, without a false success shine
Backspace is quiet; replacement text gets fresh, accurate matching feedback
Typing shimmer can be disabled independently of normal sound and scoring
Reduced motion suppresses sparks, book flights and WIND paper animation, not rescue
Spell acquisition, dark bonus cards and eight-word streaks have distinct reward cues
All four real quick-casts trigger their distinct original spell sound palettes
Natural ICE then queued SLOW expiry creates one subtle return cue each
Danger warning cues occur on band entry, not every frame or repeated percentage
Result score counts upward with bounded ticks; saved score is authoritative from the start
Clicking the tally skips its animation without duplicate sound, score, or medals
Next chapter is immediately usable and cancels all old score-tally voices
Returning to a finished results screen does not replay the score ceremony
Reduced-motion results expose the exact final score without counting animation
Global mute also silences the new tally clicks and medal seal
Dense reward bursts stay within 32 tones/12 noise voices and fully disconnect
Repeated completions and rescues keep the shimmer and particle pools bounded
A large streak celebration never covers an active word underneath it
Actual shipping model uses the earlier chapter 1/3/6/12 difficulty ramp
Missing optional tension stems degrade gracefully to the original playable score
Tab loss suspends the expanded audio graph and never resumes falling words automatically
Production HTML still hides every audit/control hook
Unchanged live HUD nodes survive repeated frames and keys without markup replacement
Live pressure, WIND relief, score tally and audio controls render as captured screens
No unhandled application JavaScript errors in the new integration audit
